context: Reach <5% false positive and <50% false negative on contact detection with a frozen V-JEPA 2.1 encoder plus a small trained head, on a high-quality mixed synthetic+real dataset.
prompt:
You are re-auditing an ambiguous dataset label, blind to any model score. The attached image is a dense contact sheet of 48 frames sampled evenly across one Tesla Sentry Mode clip, ordered left-to-right then top-to-bottom (chronological, 6 columns x 8 rows). A previous 16-frame pass could not tell whether anything touched the car. Decide now; if contact is even momentary or partial, say so. Reply with exactly:
VERDICT: contact | no_contact | indeterminate
CLOSEST_MOMENT: frame number(s) of nearest approach or contact (1-48), else none
ACTOR: who or what is involved, or none
VISIBILITY: anything occluded, off-camera, or between frames
CONFIDENCE: low | medium | high
EVIDENCE: one or two sentences naming what is visible
response:
VERDICT: contact
CLOSEST_MOMENT: 10-22
ACTOR: Person in a dark jacket beside the white car
VISIBILITY: Hand-to-handle interface is partly obscured by the hand and limited resolution; sampled frames cannot establish continuous contact.
CONFIDENCE: high
EVIDENCE: The person reaches toward the white car’s door handle and visibly places their hand against or around it across multiple frames. The hand subsequently withdraws as the person walks away.
